How the pre-order works

Clock It is made to order. Every pre-order pays for the first run, so here is exactly what happens to your money.

  1. Choose your piecesPick colours, sizes and options, then check out.
  2. Pay by bank transferYou'll see the right account for where you live. Use your order code as the payment reference.
  3. Send us proof on WhatsAppOne tap opens a message with your order already written. We confirm once we see the payment.
  4. We make your orderProduction starts once we reach our minimum run. Delivery is estimated for December 2026.
  5. Refund if we missIf we can't produce your order, or can't ship by , you can ask for a full refund.

About payment

  • Payment is a bank transfer. There is no card checkout, and nothing is charged automatically.
  • Your order is confirmed by us on WhatsApp after we see your payment. Until then it is not confirmed.
  • Nigeria pays in naira to Moniepoint. Everywhere else pays in US dollars.

Questions

Is this a pre-order?

Yes. Clock It products are made after you order. Production starts once we reach our minimum run, and delivery is estimated for December 2026.

What if you can't make my order?

You get a full refund. If production doesn't start, or we can't ship by , ask us on WhatsApp or email and we'll refund the full amount you paid.

Can I choose my colour?

Yes. Every product has colour options. Change the colour on the product card, or inside "Choose options" where you also pick sizes and designs.

Will my phone model or shoe size be available?

We cover iPhone 16, 17 and 18 ranges, iPads and Samsung Galaxy phones, plus other models on request. Shoe sizes run from US 5 to 11 for women and US 7 to 13 for men. EU sizes shown are approximate, and we confirm your size with you on WhatsApp before production.

What does shipping cost?

Prices on this page don't include shipping or import duties. We confirm the shipping cost for your address on WhatsApp before dispatch.

How do I pay?

By bank transfer. Customers in Nigeria pay in naira to a Moniepoint account. Everyone else pays in US dollars. Both are shown at checkout, and we confirm every order on WhatsApp.

Are the pictures real products?

Not yet. They are concept previews made to show designs and options. Final products may vary slightly in colour, finish and detail.

Pre-order terms

What a pre-order is

You pay now for products that will be made after you order. Pictures on this site are concept previews, and final products may vary slightly in colour, finish and detail.

Delivery

We estimate delivery in . This is an estimate, not a guarantee, and depends on production and shipping.

Minimum run

Production starts once we reach a minimum number of pre-orders. If we don't reach it, we refund every order in full.

Sizes and models

Please choose your phone model and shoe size carefully. EU shoe sizes shown are approximate, and we confirm your size with you on WhatsApp before production.

Refunds

  • If we can't produce your order, you get a full refund.
  • If your order hasn't shipped by , you can ask for a full refund of what you paid.
  • Before production starts, you can cancel for a full refund.
  • Refunds go back to the account you paid from, in the same currency you paid, within 14 days of agreeing the refund.

Shipping and duties

Prices exclude shipping, taxes and import duties. We confirm the shipping cost for your address before dispatch. You are responsible for duties charged by your country.

Payment

Payment is by bank transfer. Orders are confirmed by us on WhatsApp after we see your payment. Please include your order code as the reference.

Contact

WhatsApp or email us any time. Details are in the footer.
